flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cron tier): workflows/agencies/lta/download/{helpers/LtaSnowflakeProcessor, services/LtaDownloadServiceImpl}, workflows/datahivecontactinfo/{services/DatahiveContactInfoServiceImpl, helpers/DatahiveContactInfoHelper, jobs/DatahiveContactInfoJob}, sftp-common.properties. ocmsadminapi: workflows/reports/daily/DailyReportServiceImpl, filedownload/FileDownloadController, api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminui: pages/Report/lists/{ReportList.tsx, ReportListHiveContactInfo.tsx}, utils/constant.ts. Other repos: no code
note: Status in stories.json is 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. The 'DataHive Contact Information' report exists end to end: DataHive call results are collected at LTA download, built into an Excel file (sheets Summary/Error/Success), stored in Azure Blob, emailed, and shown in the 'Hive Contact Info' tab of the staff portal Report page for download, with server-side authorization OCMS_REPORT_HIVE_CONTACT. The gaps: (1) the report has no daily schedule of its own, it is built every time an LTA download finishes (cron 05:00 and 21:00) so there can be two files per day, and a failed build does not change the job status; (2) the Summary holds only submitted/returned/error counts, not the 'records updated' count the story asks for; (3) lookups made in the eNotification cron (the datahive flag path, off) are not in the report; (4) 'OIC dashboard' is interpreted as the staff portal Report page, there is no dedicated dashboard widget. DOS = DataHive, the Vault permission, the Excel content in production and the email recipient list cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. The report and its download are proven in code; not matching: the 'records updated' count is missing from the Summary, and it is built per LTA download, not as one daily report. Ask URA whether two files per day are acceptable.

steps.step: OCMS logs every ID sent to DOS with its send time and receive time
steps.detail: Each lookupContact at LTA download adds one DatahiveCallResult (LS:94, 114, 131) with noticeNo, ownerId, ownerIdType, hasContact, mobile/email, queryTable, callTimestamp, responseTimestamp and errorType/errorMessage. These fields feed the report (CI:102-116). Lookups made in the eNotification cron (the flag-off path) are not recorded here.

steps.step: The summary report holds the number of records sent, updated and in error
steps.detail: The Summary sheet holds generation date/time, 'Total no. of records submitted to DataHive', 'Total no. of records returned by DataHive' and 'No. of records with errors' (CI:310-312). There is no count of records actually updated in OCMS (the patch to owner_driver at LS:187 is not counted), so the 'records updated' part of the story is not met.

steps.step: The report holds the details of successful records and the exception per record
steps.detail: buildReportDataFromCallResults puts successful records (isSuccess and hasContact) in the Success sheet and the rest, including 'No contact information found' and query errors, in the Error sheet with an error_message column (CI:98-135). Columns: notice_no, id_no, id_type, name, mobile_email, dataset (Singpass/Corppass), date_time_sent, date_time_received.

steps.step: The report is generated every day
steps.detail: There is no cron of its own for the report; triggerDatahiveContactInfoReportGeneration is called after the LTA download finishes (LD:99-120, also through the Comcrypt callback), and the ltadownload cron runs at 05:00 and 21:00 (prod:148). The file name uses an HHmmss suffix (CI:264) so two files per day may be produced. A build failure is only logged and does not fail the job (the try/catch at LD:112-124 only logs the error). A single 'daily report' is not guaranteed; the content is only lookups from LTA download.

steps.step: The report is routed to the OIC dashboard (staff portal Report page)
steps.detail: The Excel is uploaded to blob <blob.folder.toppan.download>report/ (CI:267, sftp-common:61), the same path as azure.blob.datahive.output in adminapi (application.properties:118). DailyReportServiceImpl serves source DATAHIVE with prefix DHCONTACTINFO_Report_ (DRS:38, 171). In adminui the 'Hive Contact Info' tab shows when the user has function OCMS_REPORT_HIVE_CONTACT (ReportList.tsx:101-106), and on the server the OCMS_REPORT_HIVE_CONTACT mapping allows /v1/daily-report/search and /v1/download/blob (api-authorization.properties:141-142). There is no separate dashboard widget; 'OIC dashboard' is read as this Report page.

steps.step: The OIC can download the report to see the details of the records sent
steps.detail: ReportListHiveContactInfo calls daily-report/search with source 'DATAHIVE' for a date range (UIH:49) and each row has a Download button (UIH:88-92) that uses /v1/download/blob; FileDownloadController maps DATAHIVE to the same folder (FDC:93). Download in production and the Excel content cannot be verified from the repo.
